notes: Checked 2026-09-29. Employer site ceidesign.com.au is a single-page WordPress site (sections: About, Services, Our Experts/#team, Clients, Contact). WordPress REST listing (wp-json/wp/v2/pages, /media) confirmed only four pages exist (Home and three service pages) and only two PDFs (Quality Policy, Privacy Policy); no careers, news, projects or capability-statement page or PDF exists. Company identity confirmed: the site's About text and the SEEK advert's Company Description are near-verbatim (traffic signals, road lighting and ITS design and consulting; planning, design, construction and operational phases; small team of experienced directors), Brisbane office at Chermside QLD. The site names only two people, both under 'Meet Our Directors': Luke Foley (Managing Director) and Matthew Durward (Design Manager). Neither has a published email anywhere on the site, in the two PDFs, or in the three service pages (all content scanned for '@' and mailto). The only published address is admin@ceidesign.com.au, HTML-entity obfuscated in the footer; the site nowhere states that this inbox accepts applications or employment enquiries. The Privacy Policy has a 'Job applicants' clause (4.3) describing how applicant data is handled, but it does not name an application channel; section 8 gives admin@ only for privacy-related issues. Therefore contact_confidence is 'none', not 'published_inbox'. WebSearch for '@ceidesign.com.au', for each director with the company name, for the domain, and for employer-authored project/council documents returned only the site itself, its PDFs, LinkedIn profiles, and data-broker/finder pages (ZoomInfo, RocketReach, SalezShark), which were not opened or used per config. Local Buy pre-qualified supplier listing (Engineering & Environmental Consultancy Serv LB312) was loaded via headless browser after curl returned 403; it shows only the supplier name and contract, no contact. A LinkedIn listing of an earlier CEI Design 'Senior Designer (Electrical) - Traffic Signals & Road Lighting' advert has expired and redirects, so no earlier advert text with an application contact was readable. SEEK pages were not fetched (403 by instruction). Not readable: SEEK advert page itself, expired LinkedIn advert. Recommended route per config fallback_order: SEEK Apply for Jeremie/Marc (advert has six screening questions, is_link_out false). No double-touch email is possible because no verified direct contact exists; do not email admin@ as an application inbox unless the employer states it accepts applications.
